_comment: Single source of truth for VAID capability STATUS. Prose (the marketing site, docs) renders status FROM this file rather than asserting it, so a sentence can never carry a stale status. Guarded by TWO CI checks: (1) a DRIFT check — every vendored copy (e.g. the site's) must byte-match this file; (2) a VERIFICATION check (scripts/verify-capabilities.mjs) — status must match reality: a `shipped` capability's package version must be published on its registry (or its repo_ref must resolve), and a `roadmap`/`planned` capability blocked on a PR must have that PR still OPEN (a capability blocked on a merged PR is a status that should have flipped). See docs/adr/0002-capabilities-manifest.md. NOTE: `status_text` is the one hand-written field — a review item at release, not generated.

capabilities.title: Request proof-of-possession verification
capabilities.status_text: A request's proof-of-possession is verifiable by any holder of the signer's public key — offline, no service.

capabilities.title: Reference mint (issuance, delegation, attenuation)
capabilities.status_text: A reference mint issues VAIDs and mints attenuated child VAIDs; published and installable. Rust and Python version independently — Python 0.1.3 is a docs-only PyPI re-release over the same 0.1.2 behaviour — so byte-for-byte agreement is asserted at the conformance-vector level, not the version number.

capabilities.title: Cross-language conformance
capabilities.status_text: Rust and Python reproduce a frozen conformance vector byte-for-byte.

capabilities.title: LangChain request-signing adapter
capabilities.status_text: A LangChain adapter that signs requests under the VAID proof-of-possession contract.

capabilities.title: Public-key VAID document verification
capabilities.status_text: Verifying a VAID document's authenticity from the issuer's public key alone — no issuer instance.

capabilities.title: Three-state, lineage-aware revocation seam
capabilities.status_text: Revocation checked over a VAID's full lineage — three-state, revoking a parent revokes its children, failing closed.

capabilities.title: Third-party attenuation (authority) verification
capabilities.status_text: Verifying, as a third party, that a child's authority is within its parent's.

capabilities.title: Third-party end-to-end lineage verification
capabilities.status_text: Verifying a VAID's full ancestor chain from the leaf alone, as a third party.
